result.newGlossaryEntryTitle: Create a new glossary entry manually
result.glossaryMarked: Segments from the glossary are highlighted accordingly.

altModal.title: Alternatives
altModal.wholeText: Whole text — tip: to get word alternatives, select a phrase in the source text before clicking "Alternatives".
altModal.onlyOneVariant: DeepL returns only one variant for this phrase.
altModal.noVariants: No additional variants – for long texts DeepL usually returns identical alternatives.
altModal.noVariantsTip: Tip: select a single word or short phrase in the source text and click "Alternatives" again.
altModal.spanHint: Clicking a variant copies it to the clipboard. "📖+" saves the variant as a glossary entry.
altModal.fullHint: Clicking a variant makes it the new result. Differences are highlighted in <hl>yellow</hl>.
